description: Declarative skill chains — ordered, named pipelines that capture the multi-skill scenarios as runnable sequences. Single source for: workflow commands (e.g. /be-route-complete), the routing reminder hooks, and the eventual `agent-os:plan-skills` planner. agent-os/evals/check.ts asserts every step references a real skill; `pnpm agent-os:generate` renders the chains, with each skill's own `trigger`, into agent-os/docs/skill-triggers.md and agent-os/hooks/skill-routing.json. Steps run in order; each step is an existing skill invoked by name.

route-change.description: Adding or changing an API route end-to-end.

schema-change.description: Adding or changing a Drizzle schema / table end-to-end.

worker-change.description: Adding or changing events, queues, or workers.

new-domain.description: Scaffolding a whole new domain or sub-domain (the full DAG).

iteration.description: A design iteration: plan the drop in intake-files/ into KICKOFF.md + plans/ (no code), then implement the ROUTE one row at a time with AS-BUILT.md.
